中年人点了一遍钱，对王野说：“钱没问题，这些都是你的了。”

王野说：“师伯，劳烦您给找个麻袋，这东西拿出去有点显眼。”

中年人起身从一个小屋里拿出一个破麻袋，还往里面塞了点菜叶子。王野把两箱子放进麻袋，又用菜叶子做了点儿伪装。从破麻袋的窟窿里一看都会以为是一袋子菜。

何大清和王野出了门就分开了，何大清租的房子就在附近。王野背着麻袋往城外走去。走到没人的地方就把麻袋收进了空间。

顺路又在供销社里买了很多厨具。到了城外王野就开始处理食材，熬制高汤。这些东西都要提前制作。一直到六点多王野才回家。

到了家就开始吃饭，现在王野家的伙食也不错。多少都有点儿荤腥，吃的干粮也是二合面的馒头，而且能吃饱。吃完饭，全家出门乘凉，赵爷爷和王野去了练功房。

一进屋赵爷爷就问：“怎么样，突破了吗？”

王野笑嘻嘻的说：“不看我是谁的徒孙，当然突破了。我现在感觉实力最少提升了一倍。”

赵爷爷哈哈大笑着说：“好，好，好！”

想了一下，王野说：“赵爷爷，你的伤应该有希望了，今天我找到了夺命三针的秘法，现在我师父应该在研究。等我师父研究明白了，您老的伤就可以治愈了。”

赵爷爷激动的说：“真的吗？”

王野说：“真的，我师父看过了，就是失传的夺命三针。”

这下赵爷爷更高兴了：“今天真是双喜临门呀！这么多年了总算有转机了。”

赵爷爷又看着王野打了一遍拳，就回自己房间了，王野也没继续练功，就出门去找妹妹了。

王笑笑看见王野出来，立刻跑过来从后面拿下自己的小包，委屈巴巴说：“大锅，糖糖。”

秦婉在旁边看见立刻说：“你个小丫头片子，你以为你大哥出来了，你就有仗势了。我说不让你吃，你看看他敢给你吃不。”

王野一看这架势，王笑笑应该是刚才就要吃，秦婉没同意。王笑笑看看秦婉，又看看王野。那眼泪都开始在眼眶里打转了。

王野立刻抱起王笑笑：“乖啊，晚上了不能吃糖了，会长虫牙的。走回家哥给你冲奶粉喝。”

接着王野就抱着小丫头回院子了，王江河听见喝奶粉，立刻小尾巴一样跟了上去。

秦婉刚要说什么，兄妹已经进屋了。秦婉可不知道长不长虫牙，她是心疼钱。王野进屋把小丫头放在堂屋，自己就进了厨房。

没一会儿就端出了两碗奶粉。一碗递给王江河，这小子也不怕烫，两手抱着碗沿，一点一点的吸溜着喝。

王野可不会让妹妹自己喝，坐在椅子上把妹妹往大腿上一放。伸手进兜在空间里做了一个木勺子拿了出来。开始一口一口的喂着妹妹。

王江河看着王野拿出个勺子，就眼巴巴的看着王野。王野没好气的说：“你都多大了，还要勺子，要脸不？”

王笑笑看见大哥训斥二哥，咯咯笑着说：“打，打。”

The middle-aged man counted the money and said to Wang Ye: "The money is no problem, these are all yours."

Wang Ye said: "Uncle, could you please find a sack? This thing is a bit conspicuous when taken out."

The middle-aged man got up and took out a torn sack from a hut and stuffed some vegetable leaves into it.Wang Ye put the two boxes into the sack and made some disguise with vegetable leaves.If you look through the hole in the torn sack, you will think it is a bag of vegetables.

He Daqing and Wang Ye separated as soon as they went out. The house He Daqing rented was nearby.Wang Ye walked out of the city carrying the sack.When I walked to a place where no one was around, I put the sack into the space.

On the way, I bought a lot of kitchen utensils from the supply and marketing cooperative.When they arrived outside the city, Wang Ye began to process the ingredients and make soup.These things have to be made in advance.Wang Ye didn't go home until after six o'clock.

I started eating when I got home. The food at Wang Ye's house is pretty good now.It's a bit fishy to some extent, and the dry food I eat is also Erhe Noodles steamed buns, and it's quite filling.After dinner, the whole family went out to enjoy the cool air. Grandpa Zhao and Wang Ye went to the practice room.

As soon as he entered the house, Grandpa Zhao asked: "How are you, have you made a breakthrough?"

Wang Ye said with a smile: "It doesn't matter whose disciple I am, of course I have made a breakthrough. Now I feel that my strength has at least doubled."

Grandpa Zhao laughed and said: "Okay, okay, okay!"

After thinking for a while, Wang Ye said: "Grandpa Zhao, there should be hope for your injury. Today I found the secret method of three fatal injections. My master should be studying it now. When my master understands it, your old injury can be cured."

Grandpa Zhao said excitedly: "Really?"

Wang Ye said: "Really, my master has seen it, it is the lost three life-threatening needles."

Grandpa Zhao was even happier now: "Today is a double happiness! Finally, things have turned around after so many years."

Grandpa Zhao watched Wang Ye punch once more and then went back to his room. Wang Ye did not continue practicing and went out to find his sister.

When Wang Xiaoxiao saw Wang Ye coming out, he immediately ran over and took his small bag from behind, and said aggrievedly: "Big pot, Tangtang."

Qin Wan saw it from the side and immediately said: "You little girl, do you think you will be able to take advantage of your big brother when he comes out? I said I won't let you eat, see if he dares to let you eat."

When Wang Ye saw this posture, Wang Xiaoxiao must have been about to eat it just now, but Qin Wan did not agree.Wang Xiaoxiao looked at Qin Wan and then at Wang Ye.Tears began to well up in his eyes.

Wang Ye immediately picked up Wang Xiaoxiao: "Be good, you can't eat sweets at night, or you will get cavities. When you go home, I will make some milk powder for you."

Then Wang Ye carried the little girl back to the yard. When Wang Jianghe heard that he was drinking milk powder, he immediately followed her like a little tail.

Just when Qin Wan was about to say something, the brother and sister had already entered the room.Qin Wan didn't know whether she would get cavities or not. She was worried about money.Wang Ye entered the house and put the little girl in the main room, then went into the kitchen.

After a while, two bowls of milk powder were brought out.A bowl was handed to Wang Jianghe. The boy was not afraid of burning it. He held the edge of the bowl with both hands and drank it bit by bit.

Wang Ye would not let his sister drink by herself, so he sat on the chair and put his sister on his lap.He reached into his pocket and made a wooden spoon in the space and took it out.Started to feed my sister bite by bite.

Wang Jianghe watched Wang Ye take out a spoon and looked at Wang Ye eagerly.Wang Ye said angrily: "How old are you? You still need a spoon? Do you want to lose face?"

Wang Xiaoxiao saw his eldest brother reprimanding his second brother, and chuckled and said: "Hit, beat."
